messages:
marta: FYI customer 'acme' opened a ticket: bulk SCIM jobs started returning 403 after last night's KMS alias rotation. Audit shows "envelope header alias mismatch" on some wrapped keys. Anyone on rotations team awake?
kevin: grabbing logs. root cause seems like a rollout gapsome requestors still try to unwrap with old alias reference. sample: 
ERROR provisioner: unwrap failed tenant=acme user=svc-batch-01 err=\"envelope header alias mismatch: expected projects/.../aliases/redwood-svc-key-v2, got projects/.../aliases/redwood-svc-key\"
ria: rekey job status: promoted redwood-svc-key-v2 as primary at 2026-03-15T02:12:47Z. We did a staggered roll but a handful of nodes didn't pick up new config. Also seeing ~10 JWE decode errors: 'unsupported header param typ'. header example (sanitized): `\{"alg\":\"RSA-OAEP\",\"enc\":\"A256GCM\",\"typ\":\"JWT\"\}`
sam: The provisioning pipeline treats missing extId as a signal to attempt email-based merge which in some Okta mappings produced duplicate entitlement writes. If unwrap fails, users are briefly treated as "unidentified" and can get deprov flows triggered.
marta: Immediate mitigation: pause deprovisions for affected tenant, pause SCIM webhook deliveries, and reintroduce the old alias as a deprecation grace for unwraps. Can Ops do that quickly?
tara: I paused SCIM delivery queue for tenant=acme and flipped feature flag `scim_auto_deprov_on_missing_extid=false` for that tenant. Also set provisioner logging to DEBUG.
kms-rotations: rotation-complete: alias projects/prod/.../redwood-svc-key-v2 created and primary at 2026-03-15T02:12:47Z. previous alias still exists but is no longer primary.
kevin: Proposed steps: 1) Temporarily re-add old alias to KMS key policy or ensure keys are readable to legacy unwrap agents. 2) Run a bounded unwrap backfill for affected users: `python tools/kms_unwrap_retry.py --tenant acme --limit 500` 3) Backfill scim_extid on provisioner side (non-destructive) 4) Patch idempotency to include provisioning_source and extid presence to avoid duplicates 5) Add a pre-promote validation in rekeyer to reject keys where JWE header "typ" is not in our allowed list.
ria: I have an affected user export at `/tmp/acme-affected-20260315.csv` (42 rows). I can run backfill after Ops adds old alias back. I tested the retry on staging: 200/203 succeeded; 3 failed with 'jwe: unsupported header param typ'. Those three look like they were produced by a legacy client that wrote typ=JWT which we don't accept for our envelope format.
sam: Suggest a short-term fix: when extId unwrap fails, do not auto-deprov; instead leave a "pending-unwrap" state and surface in console + audit log for manual review. That buys time for backfills and reduces customer impact.
tara: Implemented the pending-unwrap flag for tenant acme. Also throttled retry workers to avoid KMS QPS spikes.
marta: I'll coordinate customer comms and draft a short incident note. Assigning kevin + ria to run the backfill and confirm no further 403s. Sam to PR the idempotency change and rekey preflight check. Tara to validate policy change for alias re-add. Update here when done. Target restore within 2 hours.
kevin: Running unwrap retry now with limit 500; will post results.
ria: After re-adding old alias and running retry: 39/42 users restored extId, 3 require manual review (JWE header mismatch). Exported those to `/tmp/acme-manual-review.csv`.
marta: Thanks team. After we finish manual remediation for the three accounts, let's schedule a postmortem to capture rollout checklist updates: include node config refresh after rotation, preflight JWE header validation, and temporary alias grace period.
sam: I'll draft the postmortem and include rollback playbook steps for future rotations.
tara: Noted. Also adding an alert to detect >0.5% unwrap failures within 10m post-rotation so we can catch this earlier next time.
marta: Good. Closing loop once manual fixes done. :thumbsup:
